title: Mixing: Mind Games, Only People by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The third of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 23 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. On this day the song ‘Mind Games’ was mixed. Work also continued on mixing ‘Only People’, although the song was not finalised until 30 August.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
